'''Rikard''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Filordus]] who, like other Filordi, had no [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. A youth during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Rikard lived in [[Efellis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] and worked as an errand runner. The [[heroes of Cularin]] encountered the young Filordus when they were investigating a plot to release a virus on Caarimon. The heroes thwarted the plot,<ref name="BotB" /> and Rikard attended a celebration that was held by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] to thank them on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="Paarty">{{LivingForce|Paarty On!}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rikard first appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''. Notes about the character encounter include he/him pronouns but advise the players to "remember that Filordi are not gendered, and any gendered pronouns that we use are simply for convenience."<ref name="BotB" /> This article thus does not treat he/him as the character's personal pronouns [[in-universe]].
